nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) tracking token balances; mutated by transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) tracking spending approvals; read and decremented in transferFrom.
Private address set in the constructor to msg.sender; used as the guard in approveAndCall.
Public uint holding the total token supply, computed from _supply in the constructor.
Constant uint 18 used as the scaling factor in supply and mint arithmetic.
Public string token name assigned in the constructor.
Public string token symbol assigned in the constructor.
Public payable transfer entrypoint that delegates to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
Public payable transfer implementation that checks allowance, decrements the sender balance and increments the recipient balance without SafeMath.
Public payable function that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval.
Public function restricted to the owner that mints addedValue*(10**decimals) tokens to an arbitrary spender.
Payable constructor that sets metadata, totalSupply, owner and the full balance to the deployer.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and as the transfer source in several functions.
Unchecked subtraction on the balance mapping that can underflow if the balance check is bypassed.
Unchecked subtraction of the caller allowance that can underflow because no SafeMath is used.
Unchecked addition to the recipient balance that can overflow without SafeMath.
Unbounded multiplication used to mint an arbitrary token amount to a spender without overflow checks.
Constructor scaling multiplication of the raw supply that can overflow for large _supply values.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter used by transfer and transferFrom.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Mint amount parameter of approveAndCall.
Token name constructor parameter.
Token symbol constructor parameter.
Initial supply constructor parameter.

edges.reason: transfer delegates all work to transferFrom, forwarding msg.sender as the source.
msg.sender is used as the allowance owner and comparison target inside transferFrom, making the authorization path caller controlled.
The allowance mapping value is read and then unchecked-decremented in transferFrom.
balanceOf[_from] is read before being unchecked-decremented.
The unchecked subtraction writes the new value back into the balanceOf mapping.
balanceOf[_to] is read before being unchecked-incremented.
The unchecked addition writes the new value back into the balanceOf mapping.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender], so the mapping key is derived from msg.sender.
msg.sender supplies the first-level key of the allowance mapping in approve and transferFrom.
approveAndCall gates its privileged minting logic on require(msg.sender == owner).
The owner state variable is the value that msg.sender is checked against in approveAndCall.
The addedValue parameter is multiplied by 10**decimals and written into balanceOf without overflow protection.
decimals is the exponent used in the unchecked mint multiplication in approveAndCall.
balanceOf[spender] is overwritten by the unchecked mint computation.
_supply is scaled by 10**decimals in the constructor without overflow checks.
decimals is the exponent used in the constructor supply multiplication.
The unchecked scaled product is stored into totalSupply.
totalSupply is assigned as the deployer's initial balanceOf entry in the constructor.
The constructor derives the privileged owner account from msg.sender.
The constructor assigns msg.sender into the owner variable that guards approveAndCall.
The constructor seeds balanceOf[msg.sender] with the entire totalSupply.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a plain recipient parameter whose only role is to feed the transfer/transferFrom transfer path.
_value is the amount parameter driving the balance and allowance arithmetic in transferFrom.
_from is the source parameter that indexes the balanceOf and allowance mappings in transferFrom.
_spender is the approval target parameter consumed by approve.
addedValue is the arithmetic operand of the unchecked mint operation in approveAndCall.
_name is a metadata constructor argument with no separate security semantics.
_symbol is a metadata constructor argument with no separate security semantics.
_supply is the direct operand of the unchecked supply scaling arithmetic in the constructor.
